comment: Layer-C integration case for mixed_deriv_2nd_uniform (grad(grad(u,y),x) = d2u/dxdy). Converts the truncation-only (Layer-B) coverage into a solved trajectory via the freeze-and-accumulate pattern: the field-level pipeline (build_ode_problem) integrates a state that accumulates the mixed derivative of a frozen cos(2*pi*(x+y)), and verifies O(h^2) spatial convergence against the analytic mixed derivative.
